reference.workingTreeStagingAreaIndexSav: Working tree → staging area (index) → saved snapshot (commit). Editing a file does not automatically change history.
reference.addStagesTheCurrentVersionComm: add stages the current version. commit saves the index, even if you edit the file after add.
reference.aBranchPointsToACommitFor: A branch points to a commit. For conflicts, edit the text and remove markers, then add and commit. Use git merge --abort to cancel an ongoing merge.
reference.applyKeepsTheEntryPopDropsIt: apply keeps the entry; pop drops it on success. If a conflict occurs, the entry remains until you resolve it and drop it yourself.
reference.fetchUpdatesYourKnowledgeOfThe: fetch updates your knowledge of the remote without changing your files. pull --ff-only rejects diverged history. All networking here is simulated.
reference.amendAndResetAreForUnpublished: amend and reset are for unpublished local history in this lab. Use revert to create a new correction for a published change.
